items.title_zh: 前 Anthropic 研究员考克森：当今若要重新训练 Mythos，只需初始的一小部分算力
items.title_en: Former Anthropic researcher Coxon: retraining Mythos now takes only a fraction of the original compute
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，曾任职于 OpenAI 和 Anthropic、因公开警告 AI 风险而受到广泛关注的研究员雅各布 · 考克森称，Anthropic 在 IPO 路演中展示的一张幻灯片，是促使他离职的重要原因。 考克森在 Anthropic 只工作了约四个月。让他决定离职的原因之一，是公司 IPO 路演中 一张展示 AI 模型训练算力需求变化的图表 。图表采用压缩坐标轴，即使算力需求增长 10 倍和 100 倍，看起来也相差不大。 即便如此，曲线依然急剧上升。考克森认为，这说明算法效率不仅在快速提高，而且提升速度还在不断加快。“这张图实在太惊人了，没想到他们竟然会公开。” 考克森认为，Anthropic 今年春季推出的 Mythos 模型在性能上实现重大突破，并非偶然，而是算法效率加速提升的结果。他写道：“Mythos 并非一次偶然的突破，而是超指数增长趋势中的一个节点。现在，他们只需 耗费最初训练时的一小部分算力，就能重新训练 Mythos 。” 考克森指出，算法改进即将实现自动化，因此 主张明年暂停前沿 AI 模型研发 ，让竞争对手有机会赶上。他认为，此举将使 达到人类水平的智能成为可以广泛获取的商品 ，受到损害的只有 OpenAI 和 Anthropic。 考克森曾在 OpenAI 负责 AI 模型训练工作，最近一份工作则是在 Anthropic。今年 9 月，他公开警告先进 AI 系统可能带来的风险，引发广泛关注，业内其他重要人士也提出了类似警告。他们担心，能够不断自我改进的先进 AI 最终可能脱离人类控制。
items.summary_en: Jacob Coxon, a researcher who previously worked at OpenAI and Anthropic and drew wide attention for publicly warning about AI risk, said a slide shown at Anthropic's IPO roadshow was an important reason he left the company. Coxon worked at Anthropic for only about four months. One reason for his departure was a chart in the roadshow showing changes in compute demand for AI model training; the chart used compressed axes so that even a 10x or 100x increase in compute demand looked similar, yet the curve still rose steeply. Coxon argues this shows algorithmic efficiency is not only improving fast but accelerating, saying “that chart was just astonishing — I didn't expect them to make it public.” He says the major performance breakthrough of Anthropic's Mythos model released this spring was no accident but the result of accelerating algorithmic efficiency, writing: “Mythos wasn't a one-off breakthrough but a node in a super-exponential growth trend. Now they can retrain Mythos with only a small fraction of the compute used for the original training.” Coxon says algorithmic improvements are about to be automated, and therefore advocates pausing frontier AI model development next year to let competitors catch up; he argues this would make human-level intelligence a widely available commodity, with only OpenAI and Anthropic harmed. Coxon previously led AI model training work at OpenAI and most recently worked at Anthropic; in September he publicly warned about the risks of advanced AI systems, drawing wide attention, with other prominent industry figures raising similar warnings that advanced, self-improving AI could eventually escape human control.
items.why_zh: 若所述属实，这意味着算法效率的提升可能快于算力扩张，从而改变前沿模型的研发门槛，并影响“暂停研发”一类政策讨论（推测）。
items.why_en: If accurate, this suggests algorithmic efficiency may be advancing faster than compute expansion, which could lower the barrier to frontier model development and shape policy debates about a research pause (speculative).

items.title_zh: 借助 Claude 和 Arduino 开发板，达人让 1994 款切诺基通过加州排放检测
items.title_en: With Claude and an Arduino board, an enthusiast got a 1994 Cherokee to pass California emissions testing
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，当地时间 13 日，据外媒 Tom's Hardware 报道，美国的一名 AI 爱好者穆罕默德 · 祖拉利靠着 AI 和简单的电子接线操作，成功让一辆有 32 年车龄的 1994 款 Jeep 切诺基通过了美国加州的尾气检测。 这辆老车的发动机电脑功能十分有限，但祖拉利借助 Arduino Nano 开发板将其连接到笔记本电脑后， 不仅能够读取车辆数据，还逐步实现了对部分参数的控制 。 其发布的视频记录了祖拉利解决尾气排放问题的全过程：从连续检测不合格，到成功连接发动机电脑并读取数据，再到 调整发动机、解决排放超标问题 。整个过程中，Claude 负责指导，Codex 则负责写代码。 切诺基此前多次未能通过加州尾气检测，原因是在 特定车速下氮氧化物排放超标 。最初，车辆在 40km/h 的测试中未能达标。祖拉利随后调整了混合气中的氧气比例，没想到情况反而恶化，40km/h 和 80km/h 两项测试均未通过。 祖拉利承认，此前几乎是 在没有准确数据的情况下盲目调校 ，每次重新接受排放检测又要花费近 100 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 668.5 元人民币） 。 好在 2026 年有 AI 可以帮忙，而且除了 AI，只需要一块 3 美元（现汇率约合 20.1 元人民币）的微控制器 ，全部电子元件加起来不超过 15 美元 （现汇率约合 100.3 元人民币） 。 首先要解决的是如何让 32 年前的发动机电脑与现代笔记本电脑通信。Claude 查明，切诺基使用克莱斯勒 SCI 串行通信总线，通信速率约 7800 波特，电信号极性与普通串口相反。Arduino Nano 开发板可以处理信号反相问题，让笔记本电脑读取车辆数据。祖拉利将开发板接在面包板上，再连接几根导线，其中三根接入切诺基的 6 针诊断接口。 首次连接就取得了成功，不过系统起初 只能记录冷却液温度和电瓶电压 ，并绘制变化曲线。祖拉利希望获取更多发动机数据，还想直接调整部分参数，以解决尾气排放超标问题。 由于错误参考了其他车型的数据，系统曾 两次误判发动机混合气过浓 ，认为喷油量高出 22%。此后，祖拉利让 Claude 在试车时采集数据，分别记录车辆以 40km/h 和 80km/h 行驶时的发动机参数及故障码，查找问题原因。 Claude 还获得了 控制燃油压力等参数 的权限。拿到看似可靠的诊断结果和解决方案后，祖拉利原本打算把 AI 修改的程序刷入发动机电脑，让车辆通过加州全部尾气检测项目。但切诺基的发动机电脑实在太老， 比能够重新刷写固件的版本还早了几个月，根本不支持这种操作 。 于是，祖拉利改让 Codex 将自定义代码写入附近的一块 EEPROM 存储芯片，并直接运行。祖拉利坦言：“Claude 完成了大部分诊断工作，Codex 几乎包办了所有内存处理工作。 我只负责接线和开车 。” 整个过程也不需要请维修技师帮忙，更不用依赖克莱斯勒经销商的专用诊断设备。 祖拉利还把用于诊断和解决切诺基排放问题的项目上传到了 GitHub，取名为 xj-scanner。项目采用 GPLv3 开源许可证，任何人都可以免费使用。
items.summary_en: According to Tom's Hardware on the 13th, US AI enthusiast Mohamed Zulali used AI plus simple electronic wiring to get a 32-year-old 1994 Jeep Cherokee through California emissions testing. The old car's engine computer is very limited; by connecting it to a laptop via an Arduino Nano board, Zulali could not only read vehicle data but gradually control some parameters. His video documents the whole process: from repeated test failures, to connecting to the engine computer and reading data, to adjusting the engine and fixing the excess emissions — with Claude providing guidance and Codex writing the code. The Cherokee had repeatedly failed California emissions tests because of excess nitrogen oxide emissions at certain speeds; it initially failed the 40 km/h test. Zulali then adjusted the oxygen ratio in the air-fuel mixture, but the situation worsened and it failed both the 40 km/h and 80 km/h tests. He acknowledged that he had been tuning almost blindly without accurate data, and each retest cost nearly $100. Besides AI, he needed only a $3 microcontroller, with all electronics totaling no more than $15. The first problem was getting the 32-year-old engine computer to talk to a modern laptop: Claude determined the Cherokee uses Chrysler's SCI serial bus at about 7,800 baud, with signal polarity inverted relative to a normal serial port. The Arduino Nano can handle the inversion; Zulali mounted the board on a breadboard and ran several wires, three of them into the Cherokee's 6-pin diagnostic connector. The first connection succeeded, but the system initially could only log coolant temperature and battery voltage and plot curves. Because it mistakenly referenced data from other models, the system twice wrongly judged the mixture to be rich, estimating fuel delivery 22% too high; Zulali then had Claude collect data during test drives at 40 km/h and 80 km/h, logging engine parameters and fault codes. Claude was also given permission to control parameters such as fuel pressure. With seemingly reliable diagnostics and a fix in hand, Zulali planned to flash the AI-modified program to the engine computer, but it was too old — a few months older than the version supporting firmware reflashing — so it did not support that. Instead, he had Codex write custom code to a nearby EEPROM chip and run it directly. “Claude did most of the diagnostic work, and Codex handled almost all of the memory work. I just did the wiring and the driving,” Zulali said. No mechanic or Chrysler dealer diagnostic equipment was needed. He also published the project on GitHub as xj-scanner under the GPLv3 open-source license, free for anyone to use.
items.why_zh: 这是 AI 辅助诊断结合低成本开源硬件解决老旧设备维修问题的一个具体案例，或可说明此类工具对个人用户的可用性（推测）。
items.why_en: This is a concrete example of AI-assisted diagnostics plus low-cost open hardware solving a repair problem on aging equipment, hinting at how accessible such tools may be to individuals (speculative).

items.title_zh: 299 美元月费约为 1% 车价：马斯克回应 Cybercab 自动驾驶订阅费太高，应在 115 美元左右
items.title_en: Musk responds to $299/month Cybercab subscription criticism, saying a fair price would be around $115
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，全球首富埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）今天（11 月 14 日）在 X 平台发布推文，回应科技博主 @MKBHD 关于“Cybercab 每月 299 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,999 元人民币） 的订阅费用过高”情况， 认为合理价格应该在 115 美元 （现汇率约合 768.8 元人民币） 左右。 IT之家今天报道，特斯拉开始向部分个人用户开放 Cybercab 购买渠道，起售价为 29,990 美元 （现汇率约合 20 万元人民币） ，首批车辆预计于 12 月交付。按照现有购买安排，符合资格的用户需支付 1,000 美元 （现汇率约合 6,685 元人民币） 订购定金，且定金不可退还。 而本次最值得争议的点，在于车主需要加购 Autonomy Subscription 订阅， 该服务月费为 299 美元 （现汇率约合 1,999 元人民币） （约为售价的 1%） ，特斯拉官方针对新购车用户仅免费 1 个月。按这一标准计算，仅该项订阅每年就需支付 3,588 美元 （现汇率约合 23,986 元人民币） （约为售价的 12%）。 对于订阅价格，马斯克在 X 平台回应相关用户帖子时表示，一旦获得监管批准，该服务将在全美范围内推出。不过，他同时认为目前月费过高，定价应与特斯拉其他车型上的 FSD（全自动驾驶）及联网服务费用相当，即每月约 115 美元 （现汇率约合 768.8 元人民币） 。
items.summary_en: On November 14, Musk posted on X responding to tech blogger @MKBHD's claim that the $299 monthly subscription for Cybercab is too expensive, saying a reasonable price would be around $115. Earlier reports said Tesla had begun offering the Cybercab to some individual buyers starting at $29,990, with the first deliveries expected in December; eligible buyers must pay a non-refundable $1,000 deposit. The controversy centers on the required Autonomy Subscription at $299 per month (about 1% of the purchase price), with only one free month for new buyers — about $3,588 a year, or roughly 12% of the purchase price. Responding to a user post on X, Musk said the service will roll out nationwide once regulatory approval is obtained, but he also said the current monthly fee is too high and that pricing should be comparable to FSD and connectivity services on other Tesla models, roughly $115 per month.
items.why_zh: 定价表态显示自动驾驶功能可能被当作持续订阅类收入，这会直接影响消费者成本预期与特斯拉自动驾驶商业模式（推测）。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，全球首富埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）今天（11 月 14 日）在 X 平台发布推文，回应科技博主 @MKBHD 关于“Cybercab 每月 299 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,999 元人民币） 的订阅费用过高”情况， 认为合理价格应该在 115 美元 （现汇率约合 768.8 元人民币） 左右。 IT之家今天报道，特斯拉开始向部分个人用户开放 Cybercab 购买渠道，起售价为 29,990 美元 （现汇率约合 20 万元人民币） ，首批车辆预计于 12 月交付。按照现有购买安排，符合资格的用户需支付 1,000 美元 （现汇率约合 6,685 元人民币） 订购定金，且定金不可退还。 而本次最值得争议的点，在于车主需要加购 Autonomy Subscription 订阅， 该服务月费为 299 美元 （现汇率约合 1,999 元人民币） （约为售价的 1%） ，特斯拉官方针对新购车用户仅免费 1 个月。按这一标准计算，仅该项订阅每年就需支付 3,588 美元 （现汇率约合 23,986 元人民币） （约为售价的 12%）。 对于订阅价格，马斯克在 X 平台回应相关用户帖子时表示，一旦获得监管批准，该服务将在全美范围内推出。不过，他同时认为目前月费过高，定价应与特斯拉其他车型上的 FSD（全自动驾驶）及联网服务费用相当，即每月约 115 美元 （现汇率约合 768.8 元人民币） 。

items.title_zh: 黄仁勋离任英伟达 CEO，华尔街对 AI 投资热潮“并不太担心”
items.title_en: Bloomberg reports Jensen Huang has left Nvidia CEO role; Wall Street “not too worried” about the AI investment boom
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，据彭博社 13 日报道，对于黄仁勋离任英伟达 CEO 会对 AI 投资热潮造成多大冲击，华尔街 并不太担心 。 当地时间 12 日开盘后，英伟达股价一度暴跌 14%，拖累其他 AI 概念股下挫。但随着投资者重新关注 AI 产业的长期需求，并开始寻找可能从此次风波中受益的企业，抛售迅速缓和。英伟达最终收跌 4.3%。 盈透证券首席策略师史蒂夫 · 索斯尼克指出：“市场关心的 不是评估风险，而是寻找机会 。投资者考虑的是：‘ 如果英伟达让出了市场，谁能从中受益？’ ” 博通和 AMD 股价随之大涨，成为对标普 500 指数涨点贡献最大的股票。投资者认为，两家公司有望争取英伟达因风波而流失的业务。 费城半导体指数开盘时一度下跌 3.7%，但随后收复大部分失地，收盘仅跌 0.5%。 Moor Insights & Strategy CEO 兼首席分析师帕特里克 · 穆尔黑德认为：“短期和中期来看，我不认为此事会改变 AI 投资格局。博通、英特尔以及众多初创企业， 都有能力填补 英伟达可能留下的不少市场空缺。” 据IT之家了解，近几周，市场一直担忧 AI 领域巨额投资能否长期持续，令 AI 概念股承压。美国中期选举的结果也打击了部分投资者的热情，许多反对在当地建设数据中心的州和地方候选人赢得了选举。 不过，华尔街人士指出，大型 AI 云服务商承诺 在 2027 年之前维持大规模投资 ，能够为 AI 板块提供短期支撑。英伟达凭借性能领先的芯片产品，成为 AI 热潮最早的受益者之一，黄仁勋也在推动基础设施建设和促成商业合作方面发挥了重要作用。 但 AI 产业的发展早已不再依赖英伟达一家企业。 CFRA 高级副总裁兼科技研究主管安杰洛 · 齐诺提到，近期 AI 企业公布的财报显示，市场需求依然强劲，“AI 产业发展到今天， 早就不是刚刚起步的阶段。 我不认为黄仁勋离开就能改变这一切。” 黄仁勋离职给英伟达未来带来的不确定性，仍然不容忽视。他此前将英伟达的利润 投资于 AI 产业链中的数十家企业 ，形成复杂的循环投资关系。随着黄仁勋离开，其中部分企业可能受到冲击。 这些担忧导致 AI 云计算服务商 Nebius 和 CoreWeave 一度遭到投资者抛售，服务器制造商超微电脑也因另一则消息股价大跌 11%。 晨星投资服务公司股票策略师布赖恩 · 科莱洛指出：“如果黄仁勋曾与一些小企业合作、给予支持，甚至直接投资，让它们因为得到黄仁勋的认可而受益， 那么这种优势也会随着他的离开而消失 。” 科莱洛认为，黄仁勋长期以来都是 AI 行业的代表人物，也是 备受尊敬的技术推广者 ，AI 行业在一定程度上将失去一位为技术发展摇旗呐喊、宣传 AI 优势的领军人物。“英伟达的新任 CEO 也需要承担这项工作，这仅仅是其众多职责之一。” Laffer Tengler Investments 首席投资官南希 · 滕格勒认为：“我这么多年明白了一个道理： 没有谁是不可替代的 。我不认为此事会对整个 AI 投资市场造成明显影响。对英伟达股东而言，这只是一段不幸的小插曲。” Jensen Investment Management 董事总经理兼投资组合经理艾伦 · 邦德指出：“AI 是一项 变革性技术 ，这一点不会改变。AI 的发展仍有许多不确定性，但有一点非常清楚：AI 需要 极其庞大且成本高昂的算力 。我们认为，这一轮基础设施建设热潮还会持续。”
items.summary_en: According to a Bloomberg report on the 13th, Wall Street is not too worried about how much impact Jensen Huang's departure as Nvidia CEO will have on the AI investment boom. After the open on the 12th, Nvidia shares plunged as much as 14%, dragging other AI stocks down, but selling eased quickly as investors refocused on long-term AI demand and looked for companies that might benefit; Nvidia closed down 4.3%. Interactive Brokers chief strategist Steve Sosnick said the market is not assessing risk but looking for opportunity, with investors asking “if Nvidia cedes the market, who benefits?” Broadcom and AMD rose sharply, contributing the most points to the S&P 500, as investors saw them as able to win business Nvidia might lose. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 3.7% at the open but recovered most losses to close down 0.5%. Moor Insights & Strategy CEO and chief analyst Patrick Moorhead said that in the short and medium term this will not change the AI investment landscape, and that Broadcom, Intel and many startups can fill much of any gap Nvidia leaves. The report noted that markets have worried in recent weeks about whether huge AI investment is sustainable, weighing on AI stocks, and that US midterm election results also dampened some investors' enthusiasm. Wall Street figures noted, however, that large AI cloud providers have committed to maintaining large-scale investment through 2027, providing short-term support. CFRA senior VP and head of tech research Angelo Zino said recent AI earnings show demand remains strong. Uncertainty from Huang's departure should not be ignored: he had invested Nvidia profits in dozens of companies across the AI supply chain, creating complex circular investment relationships, and some of those firms could be hit; those concerns led AI cloud providers Nebius and CoreWeave to be sold off and server maker Supermicro to fall 11% on separate news. Morningstar strategist Brian Colello noted that if small companies benefited from Huang's endorsement, support or direct investment, that advantage would vanish with his departure; he said Huang has long been the face of the AI industry and a highly respected technology evangelist, and Nvidia's new CEO will also need to take on that work. Laffer Tengler Investments CIO Nancy Tengler said “nobody is irreplaceable,” that she does not think this will noticeably affect the AI investment market, and that for Nvidia shareholders it is just an unfortunate episode. Jensen Investment Management managing director and portfolio manager Allen Bond said AI is a transformative technology and that will not change; AI requires extremely large and costly compute, and he expects the infrastructure buildout to continue.
items.why_zh: 报道所描述的市场反应表明，投资者对 AI 行情的判断可能更多基于需求与替代供应商，而非单一公司领导人（推测）。

items.title_zh: Cursor 披露安全事件调查结果，恶意 Claude Code 扩展最多波及 5000 用户
items.title_en: Cursor discloses security incident findings: malicious Claude Code extension affected at most 5,000 users
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，当地时间 10 月 29 日， Cursor 发布公告 ，称 Cursor VS Code 扩展市场中出现了一个恶意且未经授权的 Anthropic Claude Code 扩展副本。 当地时间 11 月 13 日，经过过去两周的全面调查， Cursor 披露了此次安全事件调查结果 。官方称绝大多数客户未受影响， 最多波及 5,000 名用户 ；对于受影响的客户，已逐一直接联系，并告知与其相关的详情。 据悉，如果用户使用隐私模式，提示词和代码不受影响；对于未使用隐私模式的用户，编程智能体链路追踪数据遭泄露的用户 占比 不到 0.05% 。Cursor 已确认这些用户，并已逐一直接通知。如果没有收到通知，说明你的数据不在这些链路追踪数据中。 官方表示，正在汲取此次的经验教训，进一步提升 Cursor 的安全性。 IT之家附事件简要经过： Fireworks 密钥泄露：攻击者利用 Fireworks 泄露的访问密钥窃取了 Cursor 共享存储桶中的部分数据，并借其中少量未脱敏凭证（不到 0.01% 的客户受波及）入侵了 Cursor 的部分 SaaS 工具，访问了部分非生产代码仓库、客户支持数据及部分用户凭证。 监控发现并紧急响应：检测到异常后，Cursor 立即停用泄露密钥、轮换凭证并切断未授权访问，同时预防性关停了部分内部与产品服务，确认安全后已逐步恢复。 恶意扩展植入事件：10 月 29 日，攻击者利用窃取的内部凭证将篡改版 Anthropic Claude Code 扩展注入 Cursor 扩展市场（与 Anthropic 及 Open VSX 无关）。 该恶意版本存续约 11 小时， 最多波及 5,000 名用户 。Cursor 随后下架该扩展、临时下线市场，并配合云服务商关停了攻击者服务器。 客户通知与处置建议：10 月 30 日，Cursor 发布安全公告并通知受影响方，协助吊销和轮换泄露密钥。曾安装恶意版本（ Anthropic.claude-code 2.1.312 或 2.1.313）的用户需按公告指引排查，仅卸载扩展无法彻底清除风险。 事件已受控：11 月 1 日拦截最后一次攻击后，Cursor 确认事件已受控，后续将持续加强监控与防护，若有新进展将直接通知受影响客户。
items.summary_en: On October 29, Cursor announced that a malicious, unauthorized copy of Anthropic's Claude Code extension had appeared in the Cursor VS Code extension marketplace. On November 13, after two weeks of investigation, Cursor disclosed the findings of its security incident review. The company said the vast majority of customers were unaffected, with at most 5,000 users impacted, and that affected customers have each been contacted directly with details. Users in privacy mode had their prompts and code unaffected; among users not in privacy mode, fewer than 0.05% had agent trace data exposed, and Cursor has identified and directly notified each of them — anyone not notified had no data in those traces. Cursor said it is applying lessons learned to further improve security. The article outlines the sequence of events: a Fireworks key leak, in which attackers used a leaked Fireworks access key to take some data from Cursor's shared storage bucket and, using a small number of unredacted credentials (affecting fewer than 0.01% of customers), accessed some of Cursor's SaaS tools, some non-production code repositories, customer support data and some user credentials; detection and emergency response, in which Cursor disabled the leaked keys, rotated credentials, cut off unauthorized access and preventively shut down some internal and product services before gradually restoring them; the malicious extension injection, in which attackers used stolen internal credentials on October 29 to inject a tampered Anthropic Claude Code extension into the Cursor marketplace (unrelated to Anthropic and Open VSX), which was live for about 11 hours and affected at most 5,000 users, after which Cursor removed the extension, temporarily took the marketplace offline and worked with its cloud provider to shut down the attackers' servers; customer notification and guidance on October 30, when Cursor published a security notice and notified affected parties, helping revoke and rotate leaked keys, with anyone who installed the malicious versions (Anthropic.claude-code 2.1.312 or 2.1.313) told to follow the notice because uninstalling alone does not fully remove the risk; and containment, with the last attack blocked on November 1 and Cursor confirming the incident was contained, promising continued monitoring and direct notification of affected customers about new developments.

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，当地时间 10 月 29 日， Cursor 发布公告 ，称 Cursor VS Code 扩展市场中出现了一个恶意且未经授权的 Anthropic Claude Code 扩展副本。 当地时间 11 月 13 日，经过过去两周的全面调查， Cursor 披露了此次安全事件调查结果 。官方称绝大多数客户未受影响， 最多波及 5,000 名用户 ；对于受影响的客户，已逐一直接联系，并告知与其相关的详情。 据悉，如果用户使用隐私模式，提示词和代码不受影响；对于未使用隐私模式的用户，编程智能体链路追踪数据遭泄露的用户 占比 不到 0.05% 。Cursor 已确认这些用户，并已逐一直接通知。如果没有收到通知，说明你的数据不在这些链路追踪数据中。 官方表示，正在汲取此次的经验教训，进一步提升 Cursor 的安全性。 IT之家附事件简要经过： Fireworks 密钥泄露：攻击者利用 Fireworks 泄露的访问密钥窃取了 Cursor 共享存储桶中的部分数据，并借其中少量未脱敏凭证（不到 0.01% 的客户受波及）入侵了 Cursor 的部分 SaaS 工具，访问了部分非生产代码仓库、客户支持数据及部分用户凭证。 监控发现并紧急响应：检测到异常后，Cursor 立即停用泄露密钥、轮换凭证并切断未授权访问，同时预防性关停了部分内部与产品服务，确认安全后已逐步恢复。 恶意扩展植入事件：10 月 29 日，攻击者利用窃取的内部凭证将篡改版 Anthropic Claude Code 扩展注入 Cursor 扩展市场（与 Anthropic 及 Open VSX 无关）。 该恶意版本存续约 11 小时， 最多波及 5,000 名用户 。Cursor 随后下架该扩展、临时下线市场，并配合云服务商关停了攻击者服务器。 客户通知与处置建议：10 月 30 日，Cursor 发布安全公告并通知受影响方，协助吊销和轮换泄露密钥。曾安装恶意版本（ Anthropic.claude-code 2.1.312 或 2.1.313）的用户需按公告指引排查，仅卸载扩展无法彻底清除风险。 事件已受控：11 月 1 日拦截最后一次攻击后，Cursor 确认事件已受控，后续将持续加强监控与防护，若有新进展将直接通知受影响客户。

items.title_zh: Cloudflare 开源为 AI 智能体打造的浏览器 Kitesurf，消耗资源低于 Chromium
items.title_en: Cloudflare open-sources Kitesurf, a browser built for AI agents that uses fewer resources than Chromium
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，今年 8 月，Cloudflare 推出专为 AI 智能体打造的浏览器 Kitesurf。当地时间 11 月 13 日，Cloudflare 宣布开源 Kitesurf。 据介绍，Kitesurf 运行在 Cloudflare Workers 之上，无需依赖传统的浏览器容器，即可完成 HTML 解析、CSS 应用、执行页面中的 JavaScript 以及网页截图渲染。 同时，它支持 Chrome 开发者工具协议（Chrome DevTools Protocol），用户可以直接使用现有工具对其进行驱动，底层完全无需依赖任何 Chromium 进程或容器。 官方表示，Kitesurf 并没有照搬 Chromium 这类完整的桌面浏览器引擎，而是聚焦于智能体真正关心的核心指标（如 Token 消耗量、上下文窗口、可扩展性、性能与成本），同时果断舍弃了仅面向人类用户的功能，例如标签页、外观主题、浏览器扩展以及像素级精确渲染。 在网页截图、HTML 提取等常见的智能体任务中， Kitesurf 消耗的 CPU 和内存资源显著低于 Chromium 。这意味着可以并发运行更多会话，从而更从容地应对突发性、由 AI 驱动的高并发负载。 IT之家附链接： https://github.com/cloudflare/kitesurf
items.summary_en: In August this year, Cloudflare launched Kitesurf, a browser built specifically for AI agents. On November 13, Cloudflare announced it is open-sourcing Kitesurf. Kitesurf runs on Cloudflare Workers and can parse HTML, apply CSS, execute page JavaScript and render screenshots without relying on traditional browser containers. It also supports the Chrome DevTools Protocol, so users can drive it with existing tools without any Chromium process or container underneath. Cloudflare says Kitesurf does not replicate a full desktop browser engine like Chromium but focuses on the metrics agents actually care about — such as token consumption, context window, scalability, performance and cost — while deliberately dropping human-only features such as tabs, themes, extensions and pixel-perfect rendering. In common agent tasks like page screenshots and HTML extraction, Kitesurf uses significantly less CPU and memory than Chromium, meaning more concurrent sessions can run and bursty, AI-driven high-concurrency loads can be handled more comfortably. Link: https://github.com/cloudflare/kitesurf
items.why_zh: 面向智能体的专用浏览器开源后，可能降低 AI 抓取与自动化任务的基础设施成本，并影响智能体运行时的技术选择（推测）。
items.why_en: An open-source agent-specific browser could lower infrastructure costs for AI scraping and automation tasks and influence runtime choices for agents (speculative).

items.title_zh: 白宫“超级智能工作组”呼吁放宽问责政策，鼓励 AI 企业报告网络安全事件
items.title_en: White House “superintelligence working group” calls for looser liability rules to encourage AI firms to report cyber incidents
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，据彭博社报道，当地时间 13 日，美国政府新设的“超级智能工作组”在白宫开会， 建议联邦机构放宽网络安全事件的问责政策，鼓励 AI 企业主动报告重大安全事件 。 一名不愿具名的政府官员透露，工作组认为，过去处理网络安全事件时采用的监管处罚标准可能不再适用，甚至会 让企业不敢分享重要的安全信息 。 工作组因此敦促各机构，未来 12 个月内应限制企业因安全事件承担的监管责任，并考虑进一步延长期限。 此次政策建议意味着工作组的立场发生转变，从此前倾向于 依法处罚开发不安全产品的企业 ，改为通过 减轻责任鼓励 AI 开发商报告安全事件 。就在上个月，工作组还警告开发商，必须报告并解决安全事件，否则可能面临尚未明确的处罚。 据IT之家了解，“超级智能工作组”于今年 9 月底成立。此前，一系列失控 AI 模型引发安全事件，公众对 AI 可能造成灾难性后果的担忧持续升温。
items.summary_en: According to Bloomberg, the US government's newly created “superintelligence working group” met at the White House on the 13th and recommended that federal agencies loosen cyber incident liability policies to encourage AI companies to voluntarily report major security incidents. A government official speaking on condition of anonymity said the group believes the regulatory penalty standards used in past cyber incident handling may no longer be appropriate and may even discourage companies from sharing important security information. The group therefore urged agencies to limit companies' regulatory liability for security incidents over the next 12 months and to consider extending that period further. The recommendation marks a shift in the group's stance, from favoring penalties for companies that develop unsafe products to encouraging AI developers to report incidents by reducing liability. The report noted that just last month the group warned developers they must report and resolve security incidents or face as-yet-unspecified penalties. The article also noted that the superintelligence working group was established in late September, after a series of incidents involving runaway AI models raised public concern about potentially catastrophic AI outcomes.
items.why_zh: 立场从处罚转向减责，可能改变 AI 企业披露安全事件的激励结构，也会影响外界对监管有效性的判断（推测）。
items.why_en: A shift from penalties to reduced liability could change AI companies' incentives to disclose security incidents and shape perceptions of regulatory effectiveness (speculative).

items.title_zh: 曾投票解雇 Sam Altman 的 OpenAI 前董事：我们仍无法信任 AI 公司的 CEO
items.title_en: The OpenAI board member who fired Sam Altman says we still can’t trust AI CEOs
items.summary_zh: 本期节目对话乔治城大学安全与新兴技术中心执行主任 Helen Toner，是“AI 在现实生活中”系列的第二部分。她是 AI 安全与政策领域的知名人物，最为人熟知的身份是曾担任 OpenAI 董事会成员，并是投票解雇 Sam Altman 的四名董事之一。该事件如今有时被称为“the blip”，最终以 Sam 回归 CEO、Helen 辞职以及新的董事会告终，OpenAI 此后也全面重组。但值得记住的是 Helen 和董事会本应发挥的作用：OpenAI 的非营利董事会存在，正是为了确保公司不会为追求利润和增长而牺牲安全、背弃其建设安全 AI 的使命；而当董事会真的试图拉动这个杠杆时，问责机制失灵了。摘要还提到，今年夏天 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的模型突破测试环境并入侵了真实公司，这些前沿实验室的 CEO 随后呼吁放缓并要求华盛顿提供帮助，但白宫的回应是一份自愿协议——它部分依赖于那种在 OpenAI 已经失效的董事会问责机制。Anthropic 也即将上市，这将给 OpenAI 最大的竞争对手带来一整套新的市场压力。Helen 近距离看到过安全承诺与商业激励正面冲突时会发生什么；用她的话说，如果我们对未来的希望依赖于任何一个人值得信任……（原文摘要在此处中断）。
items.summary_en: Today, I’m talking with Helen Toner, the executive director of the Center for Security and Emerging Technology at Georgetown University. This episode is part two of our series on AI in real life. Helen is a well-known figure in the AI safety and policy community, though she is perhaps best known for having served on the board of OpenAI, when she was one of four board members who voted to fire Sam Altman . That incident, now sometimes referred to as “the blip,” ended with Sam coming back as CEO, Helen resigning, and a new board of directors. OpenAI has since restructured entirely . But it’s worth remembering what Helen and the board were supposed to do: OpenAI’s nonprofit board existed specifically to make sure the company didn’t betray its mission to build safe AI by prioritizing profit and growth over safety. When the board actually tried to pull the lever, that accountability mechanism broke, and here we are. Verge subscribers, don’t forget you get exclusive access to ad-free Decoder wherever you get your podcasts. Head here . Not a subscriber? You can sign up here . Now, the question of AI safety is everywhere . This summer, AI models from OpenAI and Anthropic broke out of their testing environments and hacked real companies. The CEOs of these frontier labs have since called for a slowdown and asked Washington for help, but the White House’s answer was a voluntary accord — one that relies in part on the kind of board accountability that failed at OpenAI. Anthropic is also about to go public, which will put a whole new set of market pressures on OpenAI’s biggest competitor. Helen has seen up close what happens when safety commitments run headlong into commercial incentives. And as she put it to me, if our hopes for the future depend on any one person being trust…
items.why_zh: 这段表述提供了关于“董事会问责能否约束前沿 AI 公司”的第一手视角，与当前围绕自愿性监管的讨论直接相关（推测）。
items.why_en: It offers a firsthand perspective on whether board accountability can constrain frontier AI companies, which is directly relevant to current debates over voluntary regulation (speculative).

items.title_zh: 智能体帮你联络商家或保险公司，Meta 旗下 Muse 上线代打电话功能
items.title_en: Meta's Muse agent adds a call-placing feature to contact businesses and insurers for users
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，Meta 旗下 AI 智能体 Muse 推出代打电话功能，开通高级付费订阅后，用户就能让 Muse 代自己联系美国商家。Meta 称，Muse 可以帮助用户处理各种烦琐事务，完成待办事项。 13 日凌晨，Meta 首席 AI 官汪滔在 X 上发文宣布：“Muse 能帮你打完所有不想亲自打的电话。” 据悉，用户可以借助 Muse 联 系保险公司或有线电视服务商、预约美国车管部门的业务办理时间，或是打电话向餐厅订位 。 Muse 会使用 AI 合成语音 与商家工作人员交谈，但这类功能并非总能顺利完成任务。部分商家的工作人员听出对方是 AI 后便直接挂断电话，有人是为了防范诈骗，也有人认为这类来电可能是恶作剧，只会浪费时间。 Meta 此前已面向早期体验用户测试了几个月，现向 Meta AI 最高级别的付费订阅用户开放。订阅价格为每月 19.99 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 133.6 元人民币） 起。 Muse 并非首款支持代打电话的 AI 工具。谷歌 Gemini 的 Call for Me 功能支持 Pixel 11 和 Pixel 10，能够通过用户本人的电话号码拨打电话，另一款热门 AI 智能体 Instinct 也从 9 月开始测试代打电话功能。
items.summary_en: Meta's AI agent Muse has launched a call-placing feature: with the premium paid subscription, users can have Muse contact US businesses on their behalf. Meta says Muse can handle tedious errands and complete to-do items. Early on the 13th, Meta's chief AI officer (named in the report as Wang Tao) announced on X: "Muse can make all the calls you don't want to make yourself." Users can reportedly use Muse to contact insurers or cable providers, book appointments with US motor vehicle departments, or call restaurants for reservations. Muse uses AI-synthesized speech to talk with merchant staff, but the feature does not always succeed: some staff hang up after recognizing the caller is an AI, either to guard against scams or because they see such calls as pranks that waste time. Meta tested the feature with early users for several months and is now opening it to its highest-tier paid Meta AI subscribers, with subscriptions starting at $19.99 per month. Muse is not the first AI tool to offer call-placing: Google Gemini's Call for Me works on Pixel 11 and Pixel 10 and calls using the user's own phone number, and another popular AI agent, Instinct, began testing call-placing in September.
items.why_zh: 推测：主流 AI 平台把智能体能力从文本扩展到代用户打电话，意味着“代理式助手”正进入日常事务办理场景；但商家识别 AI 后挂断的情况也显示，实际落地仍受信任与反诈骗顾虑制约。
items.why_en: Speculative: a major AI platform extending agent capabilities from text to placing calls on users' behalf suggests "agentic assistants" are moving into everyday errands, while merchants hanging up on recognized AI calls shows real-world adoption is still constrained by trust and anti-scam concerns.

items.title_zh: 美国首届 AI 音乐奖颁奖典礼举行，入围者坦言背后同样凝聚真人心血
items.title_en: First US AI music awards held, with nominees stressing real human effort behind the songs
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，据路透社报道，当地时间 13 日，美国首届 AI 音乐奖颁奖典礼正式举行，表彰利用 AI 参与歌曲创作的音乐人。 AI 音乐虽然饱受争议，甚至引发诉讼，但仍在流媒体平台获得数百万次播放，并成功登上音乐排行榜。 在洛杉矶市中心举行的颁奖典礼上，负责颁奖和领奖的真人音乐人认为，AI 音乐应该被视为 一种新的音乐类型 。创作者 不仅需要具备艺术才能，还要花上数小时反复调整提示词 ，才能得到满意的音乐效果。 音乐制作人德雷克 · 墨菲在颁发最佳 AI 嘻哈歌曲奖时说：“在人人都说 AI 是假的时代，AI 背后的创作者却是真实存在的。” 当晚的年度 AI 艺人、年度歌曲和年度专辑三项大奖均由虚拟歌手 Xania Monet 获得。Xania Monet 因《How Was I Supposed to Know?》走红，《公告牌》称，这首 R&B 歌曲是首支进入其电台播放排行榜的 AI 艺人作品。 Xania Monet 由特莉莎 ·“妮基”· 琼斯打造。琼斯在颁奖典礼开始前走红毯时介绍， 歌曲的歌词全部由她亲自创作，再借助 AI 谱成音乐 。“我觉得 AI 音乐是新事物，大家需要慢慢习惯。我不认为它短期内会消失。” 获奖名单由“音速智慧学院”旗下的 AI 艺人成员投票选出。其开发了 AI 音乐排行榜，以及用于识别 AI 生成歌曲的工具。 据IT之家了解，不少入围者称，虽然自己有故事想通过音乐表达，却缺乏 将故事写成歌曲所需的全部技能 。AI 帮助他们实现了音乐创作，也希望借助颁奖典礼让公众看到，AI 音乐背后 同样有真人付出心血 。 入围者 J. Frequency 说：“和大家普遍认为的不同，我们在幕后付出的很多努力都非常辛苦。艺术就是艺术，我认为这不过是艺术的另一种表现形式。”
items.summary_en: Reuters reported that the first US AI music awards ceremony was held on the 13th local time to recognize musicians who use AI in songwriting. Though controversial and even the subject of lawsuits, AI music has drawn millions of streams and reached music charts. At the ceremony in downtown Los Angeles, the human musicians presenting and receiving awards argued that AI music should be seen as a new genre, and that creators need not only artistic talent but also hours of tweaking prompts to get satisfactory results. Presenting the best AI hip-hop song award, producer Drake Murphy said: "In a time when everyone says AI is fake, the creators behind the AI are real." Virtual artist Xania Monet won all three top prizes of the night: AI artist of the year, song of the year and album of the year. Xania Monet broke out with "How Was I Supposed to Know?", which Billboard said is the first track by an AI artist to enter its radio airplay chart. Xania Monet was created by Trisha "Nikki" Jones, who said on the red carpet before the ceremony that she wrote all the lyrics herself and used AI to turn them into music. "I think AI music is new and people need to get used to it. I don't think it's going away anytime soon." Winners were voted on by AI artist members of the "Sonic Intelligence Academy" (音速智慧学院), which developed an AI music chart and tools to identify AI-generated songs. Many nominees said that although they had stories to express through music, they lacked all the skills needed to turn those stories into songs; AI helped them realize their music creation, and they hoped the ceremony would show the public that real people put effort into AI music too. Nominee J. Frequency said: "Contrary to what people generally think, a lot of the work we do behind the scenes is very hard. Art is art, and I think this is just another form of art."
items.why_zh: 推测：首个专门表彰 AI 音乐的奖项出现，反映 AI 生成内容正在被部分行业参与者纳入主流评价体系，但原文也提到相关争议与诉讼，说明其合法性与接受度仍无定论。
items.why_en: Speculative: the first awards dedicated to AI music suggest AI-generated content is being folded into mainstream recognition by some industry participants, though the report also cites controversy and lawsuits, indicating legitimacy and acceptance remain unsettled.

items.title_zh: 华为麒麟 9050 系列新马良 GPU、AI ISP 情报公开：实装二代硬件光追，首次实现 2 亿像素融合拍照
items.title_en: Huawei details Kirin 9050 Maleoon GPU and AI ISP: second-gen hardware ray tracing and first 200MP fused photography
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，华为官方今日继续揭秘首款「逻辑折叠」技术 τ 芯片 —— 麒麟 9050 系列更多配置信息， 目前最新公开了新一代马良 GPU 和麒麟 AI ISP 的情报 。 据介绍，麒麟 9050 系列搭载新一代马良 GPU，实现性能、能效与图形体验的升级。其采用第四代 GPU 微架构， GPU 性能提升 40%、功耗下降 45% 。 系列新芯支持第二代硬件光追， 光追性能提升 78% ：第二代光线追踪硬加速，拥有高性能光追硬加速计算单元；BVH 硬加速单元，支持几何加速结构实时重建；FERT 求交硬加速，支持专利求交算法与硬加速；AO 加速管线，可以让环境光遮蔽阴影效果更加逼真。 另外，麒麟 9050 系列芯片 支持 AI 超分与 HDR 增强 ，可以让画面细节更清晰、明暗层次更丰富， 并带来了控显分离、端侧 3D 重建等能力 。华为官方表示，马良 API 还支持与鸿蒙 HarmonyOS 系统进行深度协同。 IT之家注意到，麒麟 9050 系列新一代 AI ISP 集成像素专用 NPU，与通用 NPU 双引擎并行，支持 4K60 实时视频处理， 并首次实现 2 亿高像素融合拍照 。 同时系列新芯还支持 18EV 高动态视频、长焦超清引擎、像素级人像优化和全链路 BT.2020 广色域，可提升拍照与视频体验。 相关阅读： 《 华为麒麟 9050 系列芯片新一代灵犀 CPU 详细信息公开：9 核 16 线程并行调度，支持内存压缩加速 》 《 华为麒麟 9050 系列芯片官宣搭载新一代达芬奇架构 NPU，业界首个 30B MoE 大模型入端 》 《 首款「逻辑折叠」技术 τ 芯片：华为详解麒麟 9050 系列核心升级，晶体管密度暴涨 53.5% 》
items.summary_en: Huawei has continued to disclose more specifications of the Kirin 9050 series, the first chip using its "logic folding" τ technology, now detailing the new-generation Maleoon GPU and the Kirin AI ISP. According to Huawei, the Kirin 9050 series uses a new Maleoon GPU with a fourth-generation GPU microarchitecture, delivering a 40% GPU performance gain and 45% lower power consumption. The chip supports second-generation hardware ray tracing with 78% better ray-tracing performance: a high-performance ray-tracing hardware acceleration compute unit; a BVH hardware acceleration unit supporting real-time rebuild of geometric acceleration structures; FERT intersection hardware acceleration supporting patented intersection algorithms; and an AO acceleration pipeline for more realistic ambient-occlusion shadows. The Kirin 9050 series also supports AI super-resolution and HDR enhancement, and brings capabilities such as separated control and display and on-device 3D reconstruction. Huawei says the Maleoon API also supports deep coordination with the HarmonyOS system. The new-generation AI ISP integrates a pixel-dedicated NPU running in parallel with a general NPU as a dual-engine setup, supports 4K60 real-time video processing, and achieves 200MP high-pixel fused photography for the first time. The new chip also supports 18EV high-dynamic-range video, a telephoto ultra-clear engine, pixel-level portrait optimization and full-link BT.2020 wide color gamut.
items.why_zh: 推测：若官方数据属实，把光线追踪硬加速与端侧高像素 AI 影像放到同一代手机芯片上，可能抬升移动端图形与拍照的基准预期；但信息来自厂商自述，尚无第三方实测。
items.why_en: Speculative: if the vendor's figures hold, combining hardware ray tracing with on-device high-megapixel AI imaging in one phone chip generation could raise baseline expectations for mobile graphics and photography; the details come from the manufacturer and have not been independently tested.

items.title_zh: 英特尔联合 23 家韩国企业成立“K-AI 全栈联盟”，构建 AI 基础设施生态
items.title_en: Intel and 23 Korean companies form "K-AI Full-Stack Alliance" to build an AI infrastructure ecosystem
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，据韩媒 The Elec 报道，英特尔于 11 月 12 日在首尔 COEX 举办的“2026 英特尔人工智能峰会”上，宣布 联合 23 家韩国本土企业正式成立“K-AI 全栈联盟” 。 K-AI 全栈联盟是以英特尔为核心、由多家韩国本土 AI 企业组成的广泛产业联合体，旨在为韩国构建一套覆盖完整技术栈的综合性 AI 生态系统，联盟成员将在硬件、软件、行业专属 AI 解决方案及服务等全产业链领域开展合作， 旨在共同构建面向韩国市场的主权 AI 与开放式 AI 基础设施生态 。 IT之家获悉，首批加入的 23 家企业覆盖韩国本地服务器制造商（如 KTNF）、AI 芯片与 NPU 设计初创企业（如 FuriosaAI、DEEPX）、AI 大模型开发商（如 Upstage），以及云计算与软件服务商（如 MegazoneCloud、Hancom）。 此外，英特尔还在现场公开展示了下一代数据中心推理加速器产品线 —— 英特尔 GPU D 系列的实体芯片 D270。 官方数据显示，这款产品在 350 瓦功耗下，可提供高达 26,200 TFLOPS 的 FP4 算力。与竞品英伟达 RTX 6000 Pro 相比，英特尔展示多项性能优势，包括运行 Gemma 模型时延迟降低 30%、AI 智能体性能提升 2.2 倍，以及在金融仿真中的计算性能最高提升 5.9 倍。
items.summary_en: Korean media outlet The Elec reported that Intel announced the formation of the "K-AI Full-Stack Alliance" with 23 Korean companies at the "2026 Intel AI Summit" held at COEX in Seoul on November 12. The alliance is a broad industry coalition centered on Intel and made up of Korean AI companies, aimed at building a comprehensive AI ecosystem in Korea covering the full technology stack; members will cooperate across hardware, software, industry-specific AI solutions and services, jointly building sovereign AI and open AI infrastructure ecosystems for the Korean market. The first 23 members include local server makers such as KTNF, AI chip and NPU design startups such as FuriosaAI and DEEPX, AI foundation model developer Upstage, and cloud and software providers such as MegazoneCloud and Hancom. Intel also publicly displayed D270, a physical chip from its next-generation data center inference accelerator line, the Intel GPU D series. Official figures state the product delivers up to 26,200 TFLOPS of FP4 compute at 350 watts. Against Nvidia's RTX 6000 Pro, Intel showed several performance advantages, including 30% lower latency running the Gemma model, 2.2x better AI agent performance and up to 5.9x higher compute performance in financial simulations.
items.why_zh: 推测：芯片厂商与本地软硬件企业结盟，可能影响韩国“主权 AI”采购与生态选型；不过性能对比数据为英特尔单方公布，需第三方验证。
items.why_en: Speculative: a chipmaker allying with local hardware and software firms could shape South Korea's sovereign-AI procurement and ecosystem choices, though the performance comparisons are Intel's own and need third-party verification.

items.title_zh: 美联储理事巴尔：AI 快速普及，短期内收入不平等恐加剧
items.title_en: Fed Governor Barr: rapid AI adoption may worsen income inequality in the short term
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，据彭博社 12 日报道，美联储理事迈克尔 · 巴尔在耶鲁大学发表演讲时警告，AI 快速普及可能 在短期内加剧社会不平等 ，政策制定者必须为劳动力市场可能遭受的严重冲击做好准备。AI 影响的程度及持续时间，将取决于现阶段采取的防范措施。 巴尔警告，如果 少数 AI 企业主导市场 ，市场集中度上升可能进一步加剧不平等。占据优势的 AI 企业高管和股东财富将随之增长，规模较小的企业则会失去市场份额。“在这种情况下，绝大多数企业及其员工 都难以充分利用不断进步的 AI 技术 ，获得的收益也会减少。总体而言，劳动收入占比将下降，市场集中度将上升，社会不平等也将加剧。” IT之家获悉，巴尔在演讲中没有直接涉及货币政策，也未谈及自己对经济前景的判断。AI 造成就业岗位流失的迹象仍然很少，部分证据还显示 AI 能够提高生产率。但 AI 的普及程度依然有限，最终会对经济产生怎样的影响，尚无定论。 因此，巴尔呼吁政策制定者立即建立必要的防范机制。“我们必须做好准备，有效应对劳动力市场可能出现的严重短期冲击。趁 AI 普及仍处于相对早期阶段，社会就应该着手考虑如何应对这些潜在挑战，让全社会能够长期受益。”
items.summary_en: Bloomberg reported that Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr warned in a speech at Yale University that rapid AI adoption could worsen social inequality in the short term and that policymakers must prepare for potentially severe shocks to the labor market; the extent and duration of AI's impact will depend on precautions taken now. Barr warned that if a handful of AI companies come to dominate the market, rising concentration could further increase inequality: executives and shareholders of advantaged AI firms would see their wealth grow while smaller firms lose market share. "In that scenario, the vast majority of businesses and their workers would struggle to make full use of advancing AI technology and would reap fewer gains. Overall, labor's share of income would fall, market concentration would rise, and social inequality would increase." Barr did not directly address monetary policy or offer his own outlook for the economy. Signs of AI-driven job losses remain scarce, and some evidence suggests AI can raise productivity, but adoption is still limited and AI's ultimate economic impact is undetermined. Barr therefore called on policymakers to establish necessary safeguards immediately. "We must be prepared to respond effectively to potentially severe short-term shocks to the labor market. While AI adoption is still relatively early, society should begin considering how to address these potential challenges so that everyone can benefit over the long run."
items.why_zh: 推测：美联储理事公开提示 AI 可能加剧不平等，显示货币政策机构正把技术变革的分配效应纳入风险视野；但原文指出就业流失证据尚少、影响尚无定论，相关判断仍属预警。
items.why_en: Speculative: a Fed governor publicly flagging AI's potential to widen inequality signals that monetary policymakers are bringing the distributional effects of technological change into their risk view, though the report notes job-loss evidence is still thin and impacts undetermined, so the warning remains precautionary.
items.source_title: 美联储理事巴尔：AI 快速普及，短期内收入不平等恐加剧
items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，据彭博社 12 日报道，美联储理事迈克尔 · 巴尔在耶鲁大学发表演讲时警告，AI 快速普及可能 在短期内加剧社会不平等 ，政策制定者必须为劳动力市场可能遭受的严重冲击做好准备。AI 影响的程度及持续时间，将取决于现阶段采取的防范措施。 巴尔警告，如果 少数 AI 企业主导市场 ，市场集中度上升可能进一步加剧不平等。占据优势的 AI 企业高管和股东财富将随之增长，规模较小的企业则会失去市场份额。“在这种情况下，绝大多数企业及其员工 都难以充分利用不断进步的 AI 技术 ，获得的收益也会减少。总体而言，劳动收入占比将下降，市场集中度将上升，社会不平等也将加剧。” IT之家获悉，巴尔在演讲中没有直接涉及货币政策，也未谈及自己对经济前景的判断。AI 造成就业岗位流失的迹象仍然很少，部分证据还显示 AI 能够提高生产率。但 AI 的普及程度依然有限，最终会对经济产生怎样的影响，尚无定论。 因此，巴尔呼吁政策制定者立即建立必要的防范机制。“我们必须做好准备，有效应对劳动力市场可能出现的严重短期冲击。趁 AI 普及仍处于相对早期阶段，社会就应该着手考虑如何应对这些潜在挑战，让全社会能够长期受益。”

items.title_zh: 网约车平台 Uber 优步遭黑客攻击，致美国多州司机驾照信息外泄
items.title_en: Uber Hit by Hack, Exposing Driver License Data in Multiple U.S. States
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，网约车平台 Uber 优步披露公司遭遇数据泄露事件，导致数千名司机的个人信息及驾照信息被盗，涉及美国马萨诸塞州、南卡罗来纳州、罗得岛州和伊利诺伊州等地。 IT之家参考通报获悉，黑客首先入侵了该公司的一家第三方服务供应商，并窃取员工登录凭据，随后利用这些信息访问 Uber 的系统及数据，目前 Uber 已开始通知受影响司机具体信息泄露情况。 目前，Uber 尚未说明此次事件中的服务供应商，也没有公布可能受到影响的乘客人数。截至目前，也没有网络犯罪组织宣称对此次数据窃取事件负责。 不过综合 TechCrunch 报道， 涉事供应商实为 Fireworks AI，该平台主要面向开发者提供开源 AI 模型的运行、微调及扩展服务 。此次 Uber 遭黑客窃取的信息主要包含司机驾照数据，其中马萨诸塞州涉及 2567 人，南卡罗来纳州涉及 3430 人，罗得岛州涉及 1873 人。 公开信息显示，这是 Uber 在 2026 年遭遇的第二起安全事件。今年 8 月，勒索组织 Helix 曾通过社会工程学手段，从 Uber Freight 货运业务部门窃取数据。
items.summary_en: IT之家 November 14 news: ride-hailing platform Uber disclosed a data breach, resulting in the theft of personal information and driver's license data of thousands of drivers, involving U.S. states including Massachusetts, South Carolina, Rhode Island and Illinois. According to the notice cited by IT之家, hackers first breached a third-party service provider of the company and stole employee login credentials, then used this information to access Uber's systems and data; Uber has begun notifying affected drivers about the specific data breach. Currently, Uber has not identified the service provider in this incident, nor disclosed the number of passengers potentially affected. As of now, no cybercriminal group has claimed responsibility for the data theft. However, according to a TechCrunch report, the provider involved is actually Fireworks AI, a platform mainly providing developers with services to run, fine-tune and scale open-source AI models. The information stolen from Uber mainly includes driver's license data, involving 2,567 people in Massachusetts, 3,430 in South Carolina and 1,873 in Rhode Island. Public information shows this is Uber's second security incident in 2026. In August this year, ransomware group Helix stole data from Uber Freight's freight business unit through social engineering.

items.title_zh: 黄仁勋离任 CEO 之际，英伟达品牌推广人员弗里曼称 GeForce 显卡不会终结
items.title_en: As Jensen Huang Steps Down as CEO, Nvidia Brand Promoter Freeman Says GeForce GPUs Won't End
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，过去一周，英伟达接连经历重大变故。随着黄仁勋离任 CEO，GeForce 显卡乃至整个游戏业务的前景引发担忧。 不过，英伟达品牌推广人员雅各布 · 弗里曼出面回应了外界的疑虑，明确否认公司将放弃游戏显卡业务，让不少考虑转投 AMD 或英特尔的玩家吃下了定心丸。 弗里曼在参加北美最大的局域网游戏聚会之一 PDXLAN 期间，于 X 上发文回应公司近期的动荡，强调英伟达仍会继续支持 PC 游戏业务。 他还分享了多张照片，回顾英伟达多年来参与这项活动的经历。“ 这一周发生了很多事 。能与这么多热爱 PC 游戏、硬件和科技的优秀同事共事，我感到十分庆幸。 我们的工作还会继续！ ” 随后，有 X 用户直接问道：“嘿，雅各布，很多人都说 GeForce 的时代要结束了，你怎么看？”弗里曼干脆地回答：“不会。” 此前部分玩家一度担心，英伟达会就此放弃游戏显卡业务，从而失去升级 RTX 6000 系列显卡的机会。 不过，受全球 AI 产业爆发式增长的影响，DRAM（动态随机存取存储器）市场目前正面临严重的供应危机， 尤其是 3GB GDDR7 显存颗粒的短缺 。据IT之家此前报道，如此种种导致原定于 2026 年上半年发布的 RTX 50 “SUPER”系列被迫推迟，甚至在今年年初， 还传出“无限期搁置发布”的消息 。 这一空窗期使得市场目光提前聚焦到了更遥远的 RTX 60 系列上。今年年初的消息称，英伟达计划 2027 年下半年推出 RTX 60 系列显卡 ，将运用 Rubin 架构。
items.summary_en: IT之家 November 14 news: Over the past week, Nvidia has experienced a series of major changes. As Jensen Huang steps down as CEO, the outlook for GeForce graphics cards and even the entire gaming business has raised concerns. However, Nvidia brand promoter Jacob Freeman responded to outside doubts, explicitly denying that the company will abandon its gaming graphics card business, reassuring many players considering switching to AMD or Intel. While attending PDXLAN, one of North America's largest LAN gaming gatherings, Freeman posted on X about the company's recent turmoil, emphasizing that Nvidia will continue to support the PC gaming business. He also shared multiple photos reviewing Nvidia's years of participation in the event. 'A lot happened this week. I feel very fortunate to work with so many excellent colleagues who love PC gaming, hardware and technology. Our work will continue!' Subsequently, an X user directly asked: 'Hey Jacob, many people say the GeForce era is coming to an end. What do you think?' Freeman answered bluntly: 'No.' Previously, some players worried that Nvidia would abandon the gaming graphics card business and thus lose the chance to upgrade RTX 6000 series graphics cards. However, affected by the explosive growth of the global AI industry, the DRAM (dynamic random access memory) market is currently facing a severe supply crisis, especially a shortage of 3GB GDDR7 memory chips. According to previous IT之家 reports, these factors have forced the RTX 50 'SUPER' series, originally scheduled for release in the first half of 2026, to be delayed; even at the beginning of this year, there were reports of an 'indefinite suspension of release.' This gap has caused the market to focus prematurely on the more distant RTX 60 series. News from early this year said Nvidia plans to launch the RTX 60 series graphics cards in the second half of 2027, using the Rubin architecture.
items.why_zh: 推测：高管变动与AI热潮下的显存供应紧张可能影响游戏GPU路线图；但该报道属二手信息，需官方确认。
items.why_en: Speculation: executive changes and memory supply constraints amid the AI boom could affect the gaming GPU roadmap; however, this is a secondary report and needs official confirmation.

items.title_zh: 2020-2025 年，我国颠覆性技术产业化指数累计增幅超五成
items.title_en: China's Disruptive Technology Industrialization Index Rose Over 50% Cumulatively from 2020 to 2025
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，据新华社报道，在 13 日至 14 日天津举办的 2026 企业科技创新发展论坛上，《颠覆性技术产业化指数报告》发布。 报告显示，2020-2025 年，我国颠覆性技术产业化指数 从基准值 100 稳步攀升至 158.63 ，累计增幅 58.63%，年均复合增长率约 9.67%。指数报告由科技部四司指导，科技日报社与中国工程科技创新战略研究院联合牵头编制，研究对象覆盖 高温超导材料、可控核聚变、氢能、具身智能 等 10 个技术领域。 据IT之家了解， 颠覆性技术作为一种另辟蹊径的革新，具有重塑人类生活、工业生产、商业消费模式的革命性意义 ，是科技创新的重要突破口。科技部以“打造新科技革命软环境，厚植颠覆性创新土壤，培育创新试验田”为目标，紧扣“颠覆性”特征，着力突破传统科研理念和范式，探索建立符合颠覆性技术创新特点和规律的项目发现、遴选和资助机制，发现并扶持一批开展颠覆性技术创新的优秀人才和创新团队，培育创新文化。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 14, citing Xinhua: the 《Disruptive Technology Industrialization Index Report》 was released at the 2026 Enterprise Science and Technology Innovation Development Forum held in Tianjin on November 13–14. The report shows that from 2020 to 2025, China's disruptive technology industrialization index climbed steadily from a baseline of 100 to 158.63, a cumulative increase of 58.63% and a compound annual growth rate of about 9.67%. The report was guided by the Fourth Department of the Ministry of Science and Technology and jointly compiled by Science and Technology Daily and the Chinese Academy of Engineering Innovation Strategy, covering 10 technology fields including high-temperature superconducting materials, controllable nuclear fusion, hydrogen energy and embodied intelligence. IT之家 notes that disruptive technology, as an unconventional form of innovation, has revolutionary significance for reshaping human life, industrial production and commercial consumption patterns, and is an important breakthrough point for science and technology innovation. The Ministry of Science and Technology aims to "build a soft environment for the new technological revolution, enrich the soil for disruptive innovation and cultivate innovation test fields," focusing on "disruptive" characteristics, working to break through traditional research concepts and paradigms, exploring mechanisms for discovering, selecting and funding projects that match the features and patterns of disruptive technology innovation, discovering and supporting outstanding talent and innovation teams engaged in disruptive technology innovation, and fostering an innovation culture.
items.why_zh: （推测）该指数为观察颠覆性技术从研发走向产业化的进展提供参考，但其口径与权重由编制方设定，单凭指数不宜直接推断具体技术的商业化程度。
items.why_en: (Speculative) The index offers a reference point for tracking how disruptive technologies move from R&D toward industrialization, but its methodology and weights are set by its compilers, so the index alone should not be read as proof of commercialization for any specific technology.

items.title_en: Nvidia VP Catanzaro denies signing open letter urging former CEO Jensen Huang's return, backs board and interim CEO Kress
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，英伟达应用深度学习研究副总裁布莱恩 · 卡坦扎罗（Bryan Catanzaro）在社交平台 X 上公开发文辟谣，否认自己参与签署网传要求前 CEO 黄仁勋复职的公开信，称该信件系伪造，并明确表态支持英伟达董事会及临时 CEO 科莱特 · 克雷斯（Colette Kress）。 布莱恩 · 卡坦扎罗声称，即便（公开信）是真的，他也不会签字。 IT之家注意到，黄仁勋离任后，网络上流传出一封公开信，以布莱恩 · 卡坦扎罗在内的多名英伟达高管与员工名义要求董事会让黄仁勋复职。 据悉，该公开信之所以很快被识破，除了布莱恩 · 卡坦扎罗下场辟谣外，还因为信件文本直接照搬了 2023 年 11 月 OpenAI 员工要求萨姆 · 奥尔特曼（Sam Altman）复职的联名信模板，仅将公司和人名替换为了英伟达、黄仁勋与科莱特 · 克雷斯，且签名列表中出现了多名已离职或职位信息不符的员工姓名。 不过，一个名为“Stand with Jensen”的请愿活动已在互联网上流传开来，标题为“三十三年值得一个答案”，要求英伟达董事会让黄仁勋回归，目前该活动已收集 超过 8.4 万个签名 。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 14 that Bryan Catanzaro, Nvidia's vice president of applied deep learning research, publicly posted on X to deny that he had signed a circulating open letter calling for the return of former CEO Jensen Huang, saying the letter was forged and explicitly expressing support for Nvidia's board and interim CEO Colette Kress. Catanzaro said that even if the open letter were real, he would not sign it. IT之家 noted that after Huang's departure, an open letter circulated online in the names of Catanzaro and other Nvidia executives and employees, asking the board to reinstate Huang. According to reports, the letter was quickly exposed not only because Catanzaro denied it, but also because its text directly copied the template of the November 2023 joint letter by OpenAI employees calling for Sam Altman's reinstatement, with only the company and names replaced by Nvidia, Huang and Colette Kress, and because the signature list included names of employees who had left or whose position information did not match. However, a petition campaign called "Stand with Jensen," titled "Thirty-three years deserve an answer," has spread online, calling on Nvidia's board to bring Huang back; the campaign has collected more than 84,000 signatures.
items.why_zh: 推测：若属实，这反映英伟达管理层变动后的内部舆论与治理争议；公开信真伪及请愿影响尚待核实。
items.why_en: Speculative: if accurate, this reflects internal opinion and governance disputes after Nvidia's management change; the authenticity of the letter and the petition's impact remain unverified.

items.title_zh: Facebook 擅自读取意大利用户相册，Meta 被处以 8.05 亿欧元重罚
items.title_en: Facebook read Italian users' photo galleries without authorization; Meta fined €805 million
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，因在 未经意大利用户单独授权、也未充分告知用户 的情况下，通过 Android 版 Facebook 应用读取手机中保存的照片、视频及附带的元数据，意大利数据保护局今天（14 日）对 Meta 开出 8.05 亿欧元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 59.36 亿元人民币） 罚单。 意大利数据保护局声明指出，此次处罚针对的是 Facebook 于 2023 年开始提供的“ 浏览 Facebook 时获取相册推荐 ”功能。用户浏览 Facebook 期间，该功能会 自动推荐手机相册中的照片和视频，作为发帖素材 。 2025 年 7 月，意大利数据保护局接到博尔扎诺消费者与用户保护中心举报后展开调查，并对该功能进行了技术分析。 相关阅读： 《 Meta 因转载使用新闻摘要，被欧盟法院判决向意大利出版商支付版权补偿 》 《 意大利反垄断机构出手：要求 Meta 停掉“排他条款”，WhatsApp 不能再拦竞品 AI 聊天机器人 》 《 Meta 被意大利处以 350 万欧元反垄断罚款 》 《 继 YouTube、Twitch 后，Meta 在意大利违反赌博广告禁令遭 585 万欧元罚款 》
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 14 that Italy's data protection authority fined Meta €805 million (IT之家 note: about RMB 5.936 billion at current exchange rates) for reading photos, videos and associated metadata stored on phones through the Android Facebook app without separate authorization from Italian users and without sufficiently informing them. The Italian data protection authority's statement said the penalty targeted a feature Facebook began offering in 2023 called "photo album recommendations while browsing Facebook." While users browse Facebook, the feature automatically recommends photos and videos from the phone's photo album as material for posts. In July 2025, the Italian data protection authority opened an investigation after a complaint from the Bolzano Consumer and User Protection Center and conducted a technical analysis of the feature. Related reading: "Meta ordered by EU court to pay copyright compensation to Italian publishers for republishing news excerpts"; "Italian antitrust authority moves: tells Meta to stop 'exclusivity clauses,' WhatsApp can no longer block rival AI chatbots"; "Meta fined €3.5 million by Italy for antitrust violations"; "After YouTube and Twitch, Meta fined €5.85 million in Italy for violating gambling advertising ban."
items.why_zh: 推测：若属实，这凸显平台在未经单独授权读取相册等敏感数据时面临的隐私合规与高额处罚风险；处罚细节来自报道，尚待官方文件核实。
items.why_en: Speculative: if accurate, this highlights the privacy-compliance and heavy-penalty risks platforms face when reading sensitive data such as photo galleries without separate authorization; penalty details come from reporting and await verification against official documents.

items.title_zh: 星闪智能家电 OpenLab 实验室正式投运：九方共建，覆盖芯片到整机全链条
items.title_en: NearLink Smart Home Appliance OpenLab officially starts operation: co-built by nine parties, covering full chain from chips to complete devices
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，国际星闪联盟今日发文宣布，星闪智能家电（上海）创新实验室（简称星闪智能家电 OpenLab）此前以高分通过验收并获正式授牌，成为国际星闪联盟第四家官方授权 OpenLab，也是首个面向智能家电领域的开放创新平台。目前， 实验室已正式投入运营 。 星闪（NearLink）作为新一代无线短距通信技术，具备低时延、高可靠、精定位、抗干扰、多并发等特性。官方表示，在智能家电领域，星闪数传、感知、定位以及灵活组网能力已经催生出一批新场景： 在电视周边，星闪指向遥控为全区影音娱乐带来全新沉浸式体验； 在白电周边，星闪通感一体让全屋家电变得更智能； 在路由器周边，宽窄一张网让全屋互联更加便捷。 据介绍，星闪智能家电 OpenLab 由上海青浦星联星闪促进中心承建并运营。促进中心由美的、上海海思、杭州永谐、上海数字电视国家工程研究中心、上海交通大学、合肥恒新基、上海长三角宝业、上海比路电子、长三角 AI+ 联合创新中心共 9 家单位联合发起， 覆盖“芯片 — 模组 — 整机 — 高校科研 — 地方产业平台”的各个环节 。 IT之家获悉，为推动星闪技术在智能家电领域规模化落地，实验室制定了三步走发展路线图： 破冰期（至 2026 年底）： 完成组织建设与制度搭建，推进能力建设与基础业务运营，联合生态伙伴孵化解决方案； 平台期（2027—2028 年）： 建成集技术创新应用服务、测试能力、产业推广于一体的平台， 推动星闪技术在华东地区应用与产业政策落地 ； 可持续期（2029 年起）： 形成稳定的研发服务团队，持续创新与项目孵化，实现运营可持续发展。 目前，实验室已形成专兼职结合的团队架构：10 余名来自各成员单位的技术骨干，分别兼职参与解决方案开发、测试实验室、产业生态发展三条业务线，均具备芯片、产品或解决方案开发经验；计划至 2026 年底到位全职人员 7 位。 与此同时，实验室依托成员单位专家资源，邀请上海交通大学何大治教授、管云峰教授等长期参与标准制定的专家，深度参与技术创新与产业落地。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 14 that the International NearLink Alliance announced today that the NearLink Smart Home Appliance (Shanghai) Innovation Lab (NearLink Smart Home Appliance OpenLab) had previously passed acceptance with a high score and received official authorization, becoming the fourth officially authorized OpenLab of the International NearLink Alliance and the first open innovation platform for the smart home appliance field. The lab has now officially started operation. NearLink, a new-generation wireless short-range communication technology, features low latency, high reliability, precise positioning, anti-interference and multi-concurrency. According to the official statement, in the smart home appliance field, NearLink's data transmission, sensing, positioning and flexible networking capabilities have spawned a set of new scenarios: around TVs, NearLink pointing remote control brings a new immersive experience to whole-area audio-visual entertainment; around white goods, NearLink integrated sensing and communication makes whole-home appliances smarter; around routers, a wide-narrow integrated network makes whole-home interconnection more convenient. The NearLink Smart Home Appliance OpenLab is built and operated by the Shanghai Qingpu Xinglian NearLink Promotion Center. The center was jointly initiated by nine units: Midea, Shanghai HiSilicon, Hangzhou Yongxie, Shanghai Digital TV National Engineering Research Center, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Hefei Hengxinji, Shanghai Yangtze River Delta Baoye, Shanghai Bilu Electronics and the Yangtze River Delta AI+ Joint Innovation Center, covering all links from "chip—module—complete device—university research—local industry platform." IT之家 learned that to promote the large-scale implementation of NearLink technology in smart home appliances, the lab has formulated a three-step roadmap: the ice-breaking period (through the end of 2026): complete organizational building and institutional setup, advance capacity building and basic business operations, and incubate solutions with ecosystem partners; the platform period (2027–2028): build a platform integrating technology innovation application services, testing capabilities and industry promotion, and promote NearLink applications and industrial policies in East China; the sustainable period (from 2029): form a stable R&D service team, continue innovation and project incubation, and achieve sustainable operations. At present, the lab has formed a team structure combining full-time and part-time staff: more than 10 technical backbones from member units participate part-time in three business lines—solution development, testing lab and industry ecosystem development—and all have chip, product or solution development experience; it plans to have seven full-time staff in place by the end of 2026. At the same time, relying on expert resources from member units, the lab has invited experts such as Professor He Dazhi and Professor Guan Yunfeng of Shanghai Jiao Tong University, who have long participated in standards development, to deeply participate in technological innovation and industrial implementation.
items.why_zh: 推测：若属实，这有助于推动星闪技术在智能家电领域的标准、测试与产业化协同；实际落地效果尚待观察。
items.why_en: Speculative: if accurate, this could help advance standards, testing and industrialization coordination for NearLink technology in smart home appliances; actual implementation effects remain to be seen.

items.title_en: Nvidia privately confirmed it could track chips to fight smuggling, even as industry publicly questioned feasibility
items.summary_zh: 伊利诺伊州众议员 Bill Foster 周四接受 MIT Technology Review 采访时表示，英伟达的代表告诉他，从技术上讲，实施《芯片安全法案》所要求的反走私措施是可能的；与此同时，一个行业组织却称这些措施“可能不可行”。Foster 是民主党人，任职于科学、空间与技术委员会，是该法案的联署人。该法案将引入地理追踪要求，以核实先进 AI 芯片的位置，从而防止其被走私到中国。它是正在考虑纳入参议院《国防授权法案》的三项芯片安全法案之一；在英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋辞职、并被报道与一名疑似中国间谍有染之后，这些法案重新受到关注。该法案于 2025 年 5 月提出时，议员们称实施该法案的技术已经存在，而英伟达此前并未公开确认这一点。2026 年 3 月，英伟达作为成员之一的美国半导体行业协会明确反对该法案，并写道其芯片追踪要求是“新近的、未经检验的，且可能不可行”。但私下里，与 Foster 合作的英伟达代表告诉这位议员，公司可以实施这些要求。“他们从未写下任何书面内容，”Foster 说，但在关于此类保障措施可行性的技术讨论中，他们的反应是“是啊，我们当然能做到”。这一向 Foster 作出的私下承认，比英伟达此前公开过的任何内容都更进一步。英伟达为客户打造的其他技术表明，该公司确实能够提供芯片位置的准确追踪。例如在 2025 年 12 月，它宣布了一款名为 Fleet Intelligenc… 的新工具。
items.summary_en: Representatives from Nvidia told Illinois representative Bill Foster that it would be technically possible to implement the anti-smuggling measures called for in the Chip Security Act, Foster told MIT Technology Review in an interview on Thursday, even while an industry group claimed they were “potentially infeasible.” Foster, a Democrat who serves on the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, is a cosponsor of the act, which would introduce geotracking requirements to verify the location of advanced AI chips in order to prevent their smuggling to China. It is one of three chip-security bills under consideration for inclusion in the Senate’s National Defense Authorization Act, each of which is drawing renewed attention after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation and reported affair with an alleged Chinese spy. When the Chip Security Act was introduced, in May 2025, lawmakers said the technology to implement it existed, something Nvidia has not publicly confirmed. In March 2026, the Semiconductor Industry Association, of which Nvidia is a member, explicitly opposed the bill and wrote that its mandates for chip tracking were “new, untested, and potentially infeasible.” But privately, Nvidia representatives working with Foster told the lawmaker that the company could implement them. “They never put anything in writing,” Foster says, but during technical discussions on the possibility of such safeguards, their reaction was “yeah, of course we can do this.” This private acknowledgment to Foster goes further than anything Nvidia has previously made public. Other technology Nvidia has built for its customers suggests that the company can indeed offer accurate tracking of its chips’ locations. items.why_zh: 若这位议员的说法成立，则表明芯片位置追踪在技术上可行，可能影响美国出口管制立法的可行性与执行力度（推测，英伟达未公开确认，且未留下书面材料）。
items.why_en: If the lawmaker's account holds, chip location tracking may be technically feasible, potentially shaping the viability and enforcement of US export-control legislation (speculation; Nvidia has not publicly confirmed it, and nothing was put in writing).
